records.deidentified_narrative: police responded to the location for a report of a motor vehicle pedestrian collision in which the vehicle fled. upon arrival, i observed the pedestrian to be alert, lucid, and ambulatory. he was moaning in pain and upon examination appeared to have only a large approximately four inch long laceration and swelling around his right elbow. i asked him if he received any other injuries and he stated he had recent/past surgery to his stomach, but as he pulled up his shirt i observed no obvious signs of trauma to his abdomen. he stated he walked to the above location from the santikos theatres (7600 ih 10w) when he was struck from behind by a vehicle. he stated another vehicle almost ran over him after being struck and the vehicle that struck him took off an never came back. i asked the pedestrian if he had seen whom had hit him, but he stated he did not. tid was notified of the incident, but did not make the scene. the pedestrian [medical facility]. the pedestrian was advised of the [case id]. one witness was later identified and their account of the incident is referenced in the afr report and depicted on the diagram from the view of the vehicle marked with the number ""2"". no further information identifying the fleeing party was found. coban and dme video available.

4400 block of west fm 1960. west fm 1960 is a public access roadway that extends east and west for vehicular travel within harris county. the complainant stated he was in pain from being struck by a vehicle. the complainant described the suspect's vehicle as a gray colored sport utility vehicle, no other information. the weather was clear and visibility was good due to daytime hours. investigative narrativeon thursday, august 23, 2018, i, deputy c. j. sutton, unit #41e60, was on patrol in north harris county, texas. police responded to an auto pedestrian accident located now at 4210 west fm 1960. upon my arrival i met with the complainant who was identified by texas driver license [identifier] as martin harris. harris advised he did not retrieve a license plate from the vehicle, only a description as they drove away. harris stated he was leaving from the [roadway] and west fm 1960. harris advised he was crossed the entrance/exit lot of wolfies and now was at the crossing of the 4400 block of west fm 1960. harris observed a gray colored, sport utility vehicle occupied by a white female with red hair and glasses. harris advised the unknown female was looking at the oncoming traffic and never looked to her right of the stop sign where he was standing. harris advised he observed several vehicles approaching and decided to continue walking across the driveway. harris advised he was on the front passenger side of the gray vehicle and the unknown female accelerated and struck him, harris advised he was knocked to the ground and was in pain from the impact. harris also advised he suffers from several internal complications and was returning from a doctor's visit. harris refused emergency medical services. harris [medical facility] if the pain persists. i generated a [case id] for the incident, which was provided to harris. end of report.
